tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Cream in light, near-black grape in dark.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Sunken ground: page bands, track fills, docs sidebar.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Sticker surfaces: cards, buttons, pills, install tabs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on paper, paper-2 and card (15:1+ both themes). Also the text on every fill: zap, gum, lilac, mint.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, ledes, card descriptions on paper, paper-2, card (8:1+).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Kickers, captions, metadata on paper, paper-2, card (4.8:1+). Never for body copy.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The 3px sticker outline on every card, button, pill and tile. It is what separates pastel fills from paper, so never drop it.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dashed dividers inside cards and table rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Brand fill: hero panels, app icon, Analyse tile. Text on it is ink (9:1). Always outlined: it is 1.9:1 against paper.

tokens.name: lilac-deep
tokens.usage: Links and the only brand colour allowed as text, on paper, paper-2, card (5.6:1+). Install box shadow in light.

tokens.name: grape
tokens.usage: The mascot's skin. Mascot-adjacent fills only (the ring behind a small mascot, avatar grounds). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: grape-deep
tokens.usage: The mascot's shade tone. Illustration shading only, never text.

tokens.name: zap
tokens.usage: Speed. Primary buttons, highlighter under headline words, the bolt, Format tile. Text on it is ink (14:1). Never as text on paper.

tokens.name: gum
tokens.usage: Play. Burst badges, CTA band, warm-cache bar, the $ prompt in code. Text on it is ink (7.6:1).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Ready and done chips, version pill. Text on it is ink (13:1).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (passes, matches) on paper and card, always with a check glyph or the word. Blue, not green, so it never relies on red/green hue.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on paper and card, always with a cross glyph or the word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element (5.6:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks, the install box and terminals, in both themes.

tokens.name: code-bar
tokens.usage: Title bar and tab strip of code blocks.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code text on code-bg and code-bar (13:1+).

tokens.name: code-dim
tokens.usage: Comments, hunk headers and file meta on code-bg (5.2:1). Inactive tabs on code-bar use code-ink at 70%.

tokens.name: code-add
tokens.usage: Added diff lines on code-bg, prefixed +.

tokens.name: code-del
tokens.usage: Removed diff lines on code-bg, prefixed -.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Colour of the hard offset shadow. Ink in light, deep lilac in dark so stickers still pop on a dark ground.

styles.name: mega
styles.usage: One number per page, the speed multiple. Desktop only; 120px on phones.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The landing hero headline. Max two lines, one highlighted phrase.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section headlines on marketing pages; the docs page title.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Format, lint, analyse and migrate with one Rust binary.
styles.usage: One line under a headline, ink-2, max 30ch.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline code, tabs, bar labels, pills.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The uppercase line above a section headline, ink-3. Set text-transform: uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pill padding, tab gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Code block padding, small card gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, card grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a headline and its content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Footer bottom padding, docs prev/next gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Hero column gap, CTA padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between marketing sections.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Before the closing CTA band.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Highlighter marks, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Copy button, tags, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Install box, icon tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, benchmark panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panel, CTA band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, bars, chips.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows, no blur. They are the brand: every outlined sticker gets one.

tokens.name: pop-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, pills, the eq badge.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Buttons, tool cards, code blocks.

tokens.name: pop-hover
tokens.usage: Hover: lift by translate(-2px,-2px) and grow to this.

tokens.name: pop-press
tokens.usage: Active: sink by translate(3px,3px) to this.

tokens.name: pop-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panel, benchmark panel, CTA band.

tokens.name: pop-lilac
tokens.usage: The install box only, so the one command on the page stands out.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Sticker outline on cards, buttons, panels.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, tags, small badges.

tokens.name: tilt-ribbon
tokens.usage: The scrolling ribbon band. One per page.

tokens.name: tilt-card
tokens.usage: Tool and feature cards in a row alternate -1deg and +1deg so the grid feels hand-stuck.

tokens.name: tilt-word
tokens.usage: The sticker-boxed highlight word in a headline (zap fill, outline, pop-sm).

tokens.name: tilt-sticker
tokens.usage: Loose tags on the hero panel.

tokens.name: tilt-burst
tokens.usage: Round burst badges.

tokens.name: dot-grid
tokens.usage: Texture on lilac panels and the mascot tile at 14-16% opacity, background-size dot-pitch.

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Dot grid spacing.

tokens.name: stripe
tokens.usage: The slow lane: competitor bars in benchmarks. Never on pun's own bars.
